d:
Enjoy the classic Ide Nota Ide Aata Lyrical Video from the Kannada movie Ade Kannu, featuring Dr. Rajkumar and Gayathri.
The song is sung by Dr. Rajkumar and Vani Jairam, with music composed by G. K. Venkatesh and lyrics written by Chi. Udayashankar. The film was directed by Chi Dattharaj and released in 1985.
Directed by: Chi. Dattaraj
Produced by: Subhadra Jawahar
Written by: Wali
Artist Name: Dr. Rajkumar, Gayathri
Music Director: G.K. Venkatesh
Cinematography: S. V. Srikanth
